crossRefs.note: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how they are esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of…

translations.web: twenty bowls of gold weighing one thousand darics; and two vessels of fine bright bronze, precious as gold.
translations.bsb: 20 gold bowls valued at 1,000 darics, and two articles of fine polished bronze, as precious as gold.
translations.kjv: Also twenty basons of gold, of a thousand drams; and two vessels of fine copper, precious as gold.
translations.asv: and twenty bowls of gold, of a thousand darics; and two vessels of fine bright brass, precious as gold.
